final_message:
Milk that runs out today now shows up in the "runs out soon" list. All 12 tests pass, including the new one.

The cause was in `pantry/store.py`, in `expiring()`. It compared with `today < i.expires_on`, which left out anything expiring on the day you ask. I changed it to `today <= i.expires_on`.

I added a regression test in `tests/test_store.py` for an item expiring on the query date. I didn't replay the recording against the API. The new test covers the same case: milk expiring 2026-10-21 with a query for 2026-10-21.

I haven't committed anything.
